scripts.report: npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test: playwright test && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:headed: playwright test --headed && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:spec: playwright test %SPEC% && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:spec:headed: playwright test --headed %SPEC% && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.clean: rm -rf allure-results allure-report playwright-report || echo 'Cleanup complete'
scripts.test:sales: playwright test tests/UI/sales tests/API/salesEnquiryAPITest.spec.ts && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:sales:headed: playwright test tests/UI/sales tests/API/salesEnquiryAPITest.spec.ts --headed && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:procurement: playwright test tests/UI/procurement && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:procurement:headed: playwright test tests/UI/procurement --headed && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
